milestones.title: NEAR AI answers whether its attestation reports the weights' hash (N5)

remediation: An approval for a model in NEAR AI's private hardware binds to its model id, not to the exact weights, because the attestation does not report the weights' hash (N5). A change of weights behind the same id cannot be seen there. Your organization's attested hosting (Phase 74.2) reports it. Source: .planning/phases/74.1-model-passports-use-tiers-and-western-defaults/74.1-CONTEXT.md D-15.
title: NEAR AI's attestation does not name the model files it runs
